title: calochortus coeruleus var. nanus
intro: Calochortus coeruleus var. nanus, commonly known as the dwarf sapphire mariposa lily, is a type of flowering plant in the family Liliaceae. It is known for its vibrant blue flowers and compact growth habit. The health benefits of Calochortus coeruleus var. nanus are not extensively documented, however, its plant parts have been used in traditional medicine for their potential to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Calochortus coeruleus var. nanus include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
